nodes.label: animal
nodes.text: animal animate being beast brute creature fauna a living organism characterized by voluntary movement

nodes.label: domestic animal
nodes.text: domestic animal domesticated animal any of various animals that have been tamed and made fit for a human environment

nodes.label: feeder
nodes.text: feeder an animal being fattened or suitable for fattening

nodes.label: stocker
nodes.text: stocker a domestic animal (especially a young steer or heifer) kept as stock until fattened or matured and suitable for a breeding establishment

nodes.label: hatchling
nodes.text: hatchling any recently hatched animal (especially birds)

nodes.label: young
nodes.text: young offspring any immature animal

nodes.label: young mammal
nodes.text: young mammal any immature mammal

nodes.label: ascidian tadpole
nodes.text: ascidian tadpole free-swimming larva of ascidians; they have a tail like a tadpole that contains the notochord

nodes.label: young bird
nodes.text: young bird a bird that is still young

nodes.label: arthropod
nodes.text: arthropod invertebrate having jointed limbs and a segmented body with an exoskeleton made of chitin

nodes.label: arachnid
nodes.text: arachnid arachnoid air-breathing arthropods characterized by simple eyes and four pairs of legs

nodes.label: centipede
nodes.text: centipede chiefly nocturnal predacious arthropod having a flattened body of 15 to 173 segments each with a pair of legs, the foremost pair being modified as prehensors

nodes.label: invertebrate
nodes.text: invertebrate any animal lacking a backbone or notochord; the term is not used as a scientific classification

nodes.label: coelenterate
nodes.text: coelenterate cnidarian radially symmetrical animals having saclike bodies with only one opening and tentacles with stinging structures; they occur in polyp and medusa forms

nodes.label: polyp
nodes.text: polyp one of two forms that coelenterates take (e.g. a hydra or coral): usually sedentary with a hollow cylindrical body usually with a ring of tentacles around the mouth

nodes.label: jellyfish
nodes.text: jellyfish any of numerous usually marine and free-swimming coelenterates that constitute the sexually reproductive forms of hydrozoans and scyphozoans

nodes.label: hydrozoan
nodes.text: hydrozoan hydroid colonial coelenterates having the polyp phase dominant

nodes.label: anthozoan
nodes.text: anthozoan actinozoan sessile marine coelenterates including solitary and colonial polyps; the medusoid phase is entirely suppressed

nodes.label: worm
nodes.text: worm any of numerous relatively small elongated soft-bodied animals especially of the phyla Annelida and Chaetognatha and Nematoda and Nemertea and Platyhelminthes; also many insect larvae

nodes.label: arrowworm
nodes.text: arrowworm chaetognath any worm of the Chaetognatha; transparent marine worm with horizontal lateral and caudal fins and a row of movable curved spines at each side of the mouth

nodes.label: flatworm
nodes.text: flatworm platyhelminth parasitic or free-living worms having a flattened body

nodes.label: nematode
nodes.text: nematode nematode worm roundworm unsegmented worms with elongated rounded body pointed at both ends; mostly free-living but some are parasitic

nodes.label: annelid
nodes.text: annelid annelid worm segmented worm worms with cylindrical bodies segmented both internally and externally

nodes.label: crustacean
nodes.text: crustacean any mainly aquatic arthropod usually having a segmented body and chitinous exoskeleton

nodes.label: dog
nodes.text: dog domestic dog Canis familiaris a member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds

nodes.label: toy dog
nodes.text: toy dog toy any of several breeds of very small dogs kept purely as pets

nodes.label: hunting dog
nodes.text: hunting dog a dog used in hunting game

nodes.label: working dog
nodes.text: working dog any of several breeds of usually large powerful dogs bred to work as draft animals and guard and guide dogs

nodes.label: spitz
nodes.text: spitz any of various stocky heavy-coated breeds of dogs native to northern regions having pointed muzzles and erect ears with a curled furry tail

nodes.label: domestic cat
nodes.text: domestic cat house cat Felis domesticus Felis catus any domesticated member of the genus Felis

nodes.label: insect
nodes.text: insect small air-breathing arthropod

nodes.label: caseworm
nodes.text: caseworm insect larva that constructs a protective case around its body

nodes.label: caddisworm
nodes.text: caddisworm strawworm larva of the caddis fly; constructs a case of silk covered with sand or plant debris

nodes.label: cankerworm
nodes.text: cankerworm green caterpillar of a geometrid moth; pest of various fruit and shade trees

nodes.label: cutworm
nodes.text: cutworm North American moth whose larvae feed on young plant stems cutting them off at the ground

nodes.label: webworm
nodes.text: webworm several gregarious moth larvae that spin webs over foliage on which they feed

nodes.label: caterpillar
nodes.text: caterpillar a wormlike and often brightly colored and hairy or spiny larva of a butterfly or moth

nodes.label: bollworm
nodes.text: bollworm any of various moth caterpillars that destroy cotton bolls

nodes.label: larva
nodes.text: larva the immature free-living form of most invertebrates and amphibians and fish which at hatching from the egg is fundamentally unlike its parent and must metamorphose

nodes.label: grub
nodes.text: grub a soft thick wormlike larva of certain beetles and other insects

nodes.label: maggot
nodes.text: maggot the larva of the housefly and blowfly commonly found in decaying organic matter

nodes.label: leatherjacket
nodes.text: leatherjacket tough-skinned larva of certain crane flies

nodes.label: echinoderm
nodes.text: echinoderm marine invertebrates with tube feet and five-part radially symmetrical bodies

nodes.label: basket star
nodes.text: basket star basket fish any starfish-like animal of the genera Euryale or Astrophyton or Gorgonocephalus having slender complexly branched interlacing arms radiating from a central disc

nodes.label: sea urchin
nodes.text: sea urchin shallow-water echinoderms having soft bodies enclosed in thin spiny globular shells

nodes.label: crinoid
nodes.text: crinoid primitive echinoderms having five or more feathery arms radiating from a central disk

nodes.label: sea cucumber
nodes.text: sea cucumber holothurian echinoderm having a flexible sausage-shaped body, tentacles surrounding the mouth and tube feet; free-living mud feeders

nodes.label: young fish
nodes.text: young fish a fish that is young

selection_policy.spanning_tree_policy: breadth-first; lexicographic synset-id child selection; repeated nodes omitted
